extends: wave-d2/d2-09 (script imported as a module; all d2-09 checks re-run against the post-D/D2/D3/D4 tip, then wave-e checks layered on top)

registry.growthSinceD209: freshCandidates 6→8, quarantined 13→22, searchChecks added — all new entries pass field/hash checks

urlProbes.note: d2-09 probed HEAD/ranged-GET only; e24 re-probes failures with plain GET (curl -g). dvidshub + voanews recover to 200; remaining dead: health.mil/search 404 (endpoint moved) and youtube.com/@VeteransAffairs 404 (handle gone; verified with browser UA)

labelSchema.detail: 8 wave-D/D2 annotation files (devin-visual-v3-waveD.json x2, v4-waveD2-ownership-audit.json x3, v4-waveD2-ta.json x3) omit 'revision'; captureBundle/annotatorId/schemaVersion/createdAtIso conform in all 59 files

sidecarConsistency.note: all paddle-bench.json / ball-bench.json / stroke-gold / event-bounds references resolve (gitignored videos/, runs/, corpus media/ excluded by design)

heldOutIsolation.bundleAnnotations: both held-out bundles contain only baseline devin-visual-v1.json
heldOutIsolation.goldCollections: 0 held-out entries in stroke-gold (29), ta-bench cases (301), event-bounds-wave-a
heldOutIsolation.textualReferenceNote: id mentions in bench case listings, run artifacts, QA records, registries, exclusion notes — recorded in report, not violations; no held-out label content was viewed
heldOutIsolation.releaseBaselineComparison: afn-vic-rally1 release copy byte-identical (rev 4 == rev 4); wm-dink-01 release copy rev 5 != live bundle rev 8 — ESCALATED

mechanicalFixes: none required in dataset files themselves — all inconsistencies found were either audit-classifier staleness (fixed inside the e24 script: d2-03's two new quarantine statuses accepted as vocabulary extensions; URL probe false-negatives re-probed with plain GET/-g; prose search-log entries classified not-probeable) or semantic items escalated below

escalations.what: releases/pickle-real-v0.3/annotations/wm-dink-01.json (revision 5) differs from the live held-out baseline bundles/wm-dink-01/annotation/devin-visual-v1.json (revision 8)
escalations.whyNotFixed: releases are immutable snapshots and held-out label content must not be touched; both files date to the pre-history squash commit 52ba173 so git cannot show when/why revisions 6-8 landed. Needs integrator adjudication on whether the post-freeze baseline revisions were compliant (afn-vic-rally1 is byte-identical, so this is specific to wm-dink-01).

escalations.what: 8 wave-D/D2 annotation sidecars omit the 'revision' envelope field
escalations.whyNotFixed: datasets are append-only and these are other annotators' files; adding revision:1 would rewrite their records. Recommend the owning annotator (or an adjudication record) adds it, or the envelope contract is versioned to make revision optional for audit/ta modalities.

escalations.what: 2 genuinely dead registry search-log URLs: health.mil/search?query=pickleball (404, endpoint moved) and youtube.com/@VeteransAffairs (404 even with browser UA — handle gone)
escalations.whyNotFixed: officialSearchChecks entries are historical search-log records; rewriting them would falsify the log. Future acquisition passes should re-derive working endpoints.

escalations.what: 3 stale corpus split assignments (dvids-956784/957519/967848) still reference sessions merged away by phash dedup
escalations.whyNotFixed: carried over from d2-09 unchanged; deterministic split-reuse semantics are owned by the data engine (d2-09 finding, still true post-merges)

findings: Post-merge dataset tree is internally consistent: 8/8 fresh-candidate and 9/9 ood sha256+bytes match, 3/3 release manifests verify, 0 duplicate ids across 8 id collections (461 ids), 0 duplicate sha256 across 43 registered media hashes, 0 broken sidecar references, 0 orphan bundles, all 11 dataset dirs carry a DATA_CARD.md whose referenced paths all resolve.

Held-out isolation holds where it matters: both held-out bundles contain only the baseline annotation, and 0 of 29 stroke-gold labels / 301 ta-bench cases / event-bounds-wave-a cases touch held-out cases. The one exception is the wm-dink-01 release-snapshot vs live-baseline revision drift (5 vs 8), escalated for adjudication.

Wave D/D2 growth is clean but relaxed the annotation envelope: the 8 new modality sidecars (waveD contact, waveD2 ownership-audit/ta) dropped 'revision' — a contract-versioning decision, not silently fixable here.

d2-09's URL prober under-reports availability: 6 of its 11 dead_url findings were probe artifacts (ranged-GET-hostile hosts, curl globbing on [type], prose search-log entries); only 2 URLs are genuinely dead.
